fonts: Archivo (SIL Open Font License): NDA Display Bold and Heavy are static instances of it; the variable font sets the intro's disciplines
Google Fonts: Barlow, IBM Plex Mono, Satisfy (The Graphic's neon only)

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Paper: the mockup's cool off-white. Night: the intro film's black. Every other surface sits on it.

tokens.name: paper-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for outline buttons and menu rows. Holds `ink` text only (never `blue`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, display type, filled buttons, circle outlines and icons. On `paper`, `paper-hover`, `screening-bg`, `banner-bg` and the pigment wash: at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-mid
tokens.usage: Secondary reading copy: seminar descriptions, intros. On `paper` and `paper-hover` (10.8:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Metadata: dates, session numbers, captions, Past/Screened status, locked readings. On `paper` and `screening-bg` (5.3:1 or more in both themes). Not on washes or images.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill: the primary button label, a hovered circle link's arrow.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Full-width 1px section rules: under the header, between homepage rows, above the footer. Decorative.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: 1px vertical column dividers, input and checkbox borders, footer separators. At least 3:1 on `paper` in both themes, so it can mark a control's edge.

tokens.name: rule-thin
tokens.usage: The line inside an IndexRule, session dividers and list rules. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Current status as text: 'In progress', 'Active', the current session title, 'Stream here' links, text-link hover. On `paper` and `screening-bg` (5.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: pink-mark
tokens.usage: Marks for current status: the 3px rule above the current session, the current screening's left edge, the filled status square. Non-text, 3:1 or more on `paper` and `screening-bg`.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Links inside reading lists and the 'Next' status. Text on `paper` only (4.7:1 Paper, 7.0:1 Night).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 4px offset. 3:1 or more on `paper`, `screening-bg`, `banner-bg` and the pigment wash in both themes.

tokens.name: screening-bg
tokens.usage: The pale blue screening panel nested under a session's lecture. Only screenings live here.

tokens.name: screening-ink
tokens.usage: The screening summary line ('Screenings: 16 September ...') and screening titles. On `screening-bg` (7.8:1 Paper, 8.2:1 Night).

tokens.name: screening-rule
tokens.usage: Dividers between screening rows inside `screening-bg`. Decorative.

tokens.name: banner-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the screening-night banner under the header. Holds `ink` text.

tokens.name: pigment-blue
tokens.usage: Pigment film: the bright blue paint. Imagery, washes and the cover only; as UI it reaches you through `blue`.

tokens.name: pigment-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Pigment film: blue in shadow. Imagery; the source of `focus`.

tokens.name: pigment-pink
tokens.usage: Pigment film: the bright pink paint. Imagery; the source of `pink-mark`. Too light for small text on `paper` (4.2:1).

tokens.name: pigment-magenta
tokens.usage: Pigment film: pink in shadow. Imagery; the source of `pink`.

tokens.name: pigment-plum
tokens.usage: Pigment film: the deepest magenta, where the paint pools. Imagery and the cover only.

tokens.name: pigment-violet
tokens.usage: Pigment film: where blue and pink mix. Imagery and the cover only.

styles.name: hero-word
styles.usage: The one hero word, filled by the pigment film (LiquidWord). Heavy, tracked -.03em, drawn 1.6 times its natural height (`--nda-word-stretch`) so its capitals are 30% of the column, as in the intro film. Fitted to its column: about 130px at a 1440px desktop.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: The hero statement's lead line, fitted to the hero column (about 74px at 1440px). Word spaces open by `--nda-display-words` (.1em).

styles.name: display-sm
styles.sample: IS THE HOME OF WEB3 AND
styles.usage: The hero statement's second line, fitted to the column (about 55px at 1440px).

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Program and Seminar access titles, fitted to their panel (about 64px at 1440px).

styles.name: display-headline
styles.usage: Page titles on seminar and directory pages.

styles.name: display-wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the site header.

styles.name: display-session-lg
styles.usage: The current session's title; the footer wordmark.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Navigation, footer links, IndexRule labels, status words. Uppercase.

styles.name: mono-wide
styles.usage: Taglines, program subtitles, circle-link labels, stacked tag lists. Uppercase, two lines at most.

styles.name: mono-index
styles.usage: The two-digit numeral that opens an IndexRule; session numbers.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Copyright, legal line, small print, timestamps.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Small section heads above a group of panels (Seminar access, The journal). Uppercase.

styles.name: text-lede
styles.sample: Free public seminars exploring Web3 through economics, philosophy and art.
styles.usage: Intros and seminar decks; one paragraph.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: A seminar on sexual desire, the unconscious, and the limits of knowledge.
styles.usage: Reading copy, reading lists, policy text.

styles.name: text-small
styles.sample: Sex, and/or Love · 10 p.m.–2 a.m. Eastern

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Screening notes, field help, locked-reading notes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, status square to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a numeral and its rule; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Title to subtitle in a panel; label rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding inside column dividers; IndexRule to title.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Circle to label in a CircleLink; section head to first IndexRule.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; field stacks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Title to CircleLink; session grid column gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space above and below a homepage row.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on content pages.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large vertical breaks between page regions.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The default: panels, images, inputs, banners, badges are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons only (Connect wallet).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circle links and the radio control.

stroke.note: Line weights. Rules are always 1px; circles and icons 1.5px.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and divider; input borders.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Circle-link and radio outlines; icon strokes.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The current session's top rule; the focus ring width.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header row.

tokens.name: circle
tokens.usage: CircleLink diameter.

tokens.name: circle-sm
tokens.usage: Radio play/pause diameter.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Inputs and default buttons (touch target).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: The header's Connect wallet button.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of reading copy.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width; the grid centres beyond it.

duration.note: Motion timings. Under prefers-reduced-motion, transitions drop to 0.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Link colour, circle fill, button hover.

tokens.name: dur-wash
tokens.usage: The pigment wash fading in on a hovered or focused panel.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: The intro's diagonal curtain onto THOUGHT; page-load reveals.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives: wash, reveals, the intro's words.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: The intro's row-to-row scrolls and the curtain.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: Screening-night banner, under the header.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky site header and its menu.

tokens.name: z-intro
tokens.usage: The first-visit intro overlay: above everything on the page, the family's Neta DAO Radio bar (z 2147483000) included.
